title: Ceiling bound for the input scale
statement: Let $n$, $a$, and $c$ be positive integers with $2a\leq c$. Define $\varepsilon=a/c$ and $s=\lceil nc/a\rceil$. Then $s\leq n/\varepsilon+1$.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the numerator is at most the denominator
